snippet.title: Gravethorn | Announcement Trailer | PC
snippet.description:
Gravethorn, a dark and sorrowful world where tragedy, curses, and relentless horrors shape your fate. As the Inquisitor, you must navigate a decaying realm, uncover its hidden secrets, and confront the horrors lurking in the shadows.

🩸 Fast paced brutal combat – Punishing yet rewarding battles
🕰️ Non-linear Metroidvania world – Explore a labyrinth of secrets
🔮 A haunting gothic tale – Dive into a world of sorrow and tragedy

🔥 Wishlist Gravethorn on Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/3567010/

Website: https://www.volviir.com
Twitter/X: https://x.com/volviirdev
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/volviirdev/

#Gravethorn #IndieGame #Soulslike #Metroidvania #DarkFantasy
